summary: Silvercorp Metals, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, plus CFO/CEO certifications and a consent of Guoliang Ma incorporated into its Form F-10 shelf registration. No transaction, tender, activist, strategic-review, or capital-structure event is disclosed; the filing is routine quarterly reporting. Results show quarterly revenue of $72.1 million and net income of $11.5 million, with a $53.2 million derivative liability loss. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are stated.
